concepts.label: evpn-instance
concepts.gloss: A logical EVPN service instance (EVI) that defines a MAC-VRF and is realized on a specific attachment circuit.

concepts.label: attachment-circuit
concepts.gloss: The attachment circuit (AC) is the interface that anchors an EVPN MAC-VRF and connects to a customer network.

concepts.label: vpn-network-access
concepts.gloss: A VPN network access point (endpoint) that attaches to a particular attachment circuit and provides customer-facing connectivity.

concepts.label: bridge-domain
concepts.gloss: A bridge domain (L2 domain) belonging to an EVPN instance, representing a specific VLAN within the EVI.

concepts.label: ingress-policer
concepts.gloss: An ingress policer that enforces rate limits on traffic entering through an attachment circuit.

concepts.label: traffic-class
concepts.gloss: A traffic class (COS) within an EVPN EVI used to categorize frames (e.g., EF or BE).

concepts.label: mac-vrf-learning
concepts.gloss: Local MAC learning control for the MAC-VRF on an attachment circuit.

concepts.label: interface-mtu
concepts.gloss: Interface MTU setting on an attachment circuit, determining the maximum frame size.

concepts.label: ethernet-segment
concepts.gloss: An Ethernet Segment used for multihoming of a MAC-VRF, spanning one or more attachment circuits.

concepts.label: MAC-mobility
concepts.gloss: MAC mobility control within EVPN to move a MAC address between EVI contexts.
concepts.example: mobility seq=3 for a moved MAC
instances: mobility seq=3 for a moved MAC

concepts.label: vendor-evi-tag
concepts.gloss: An opaque, vendor-specific EVI tag associated with an EVPN instance.
